For M=128: 126. So phase ∈ [0,126]. Reconstruction: k*(256//N), k up to M-1=N/2-1, phase max = (N/2-1)*(256/N) = 128 - 256/N ≤ 127. So phase ∈ [0,127].

_twiddle computes cos and -sin of angle 2π*phase/256? Desired e^{-iθ} with θ=2π*phase/256 presumably: wr=cos θ, wi=-sin θ.

Check _twiddle: folded = min(phase, 128-phase) ∈ [0,64]. cosine=TABLE[folded]. TABLE[j]=cos(2π j/256). Sign flip: phase<=64 keep, else negate. So cosine = cos(2π phase/256) for phase≤64; for phase in (64,128), folded=128-phase, TABLE[folded]=cos(2π(128-phase)/256)= -cos(2π phase/256)... wait cos(π - x) = -cos(x). So sign flip yields +cos(2π phase/256)? Let's check: phase=100. True cos(2π·100/256)=cos(2.454 rad)≈ -0.777. folded=28, TABLE[28]=cos(2π·28/256)=cos(0.687)=0.773. Hmm cos(π−x)... 2π·28/256 = 0.687 rad; π−0.687=2.454. cos(2.454)=−0.773. So sign flip gives −0.773 ✓. Good.

sine: TABLE[|64−phase|] = cos(2π|64−phase|/256) = sin(2π phase/256) for phase in [0,128]: for phase≤64, 64−phase ≥0, cos(π/2 − θ')= sin(θ') where θ'=2π phase/256 ✓. For phase>64: |64−phase|=phase−64, cos(θ−π/2)=sin θ ✓. So sine=sin θ. Returns -sine = −sin θ. So (wr, wi)=(cosθ, −sinθ)=e^{−iθ}. OK.

2. Reconstruction formula. Standard packed real FFT: with Z = FFT_M of z[n]=x[2n]+i·x[2n+1], X[k] for k=0..M (M=N/2):
X[k] = (Z[k] + conj(Z[M−k]))/2 + e^{−2πik/N}·(Z[k] − conj(Z[M−k]))/(2i).

Let Z[k]=ar+i·ai at address k, and Z[M−k]=br+i·bi (partner). conj(Z[M−k])=br−i·bi.

A = (Z[k]+conj(Z[M−k]))/2 = ((ar+br) + i(ai−bi))/2 = (sr + i·si)/2.
B = (Z[k]−conj(Z[M−k]))/(2i) = ((ar−br)+i(ai+bi))/(2i) = (di − i·dr)/2 where di=ai+bi, dr=ar−br. So B = (di/2) − i(dr/2).

X[k] = A + e^{−iφ}(B), φ=2πk/N. e^{−iφ}=wr+i·wi with wr=cosφ, wi=−sinφ.
e^{−iφ}·B = (wr+i·wi)(di/2 − i dr/2) = (wr·di + wi·dr)/2 + i(wi·di − wr·dr)/2.

X[k] real = (sr + wr·di + wi·dr)/2 ✓ matches line 79.
X[k] imag = (si + wi·di − wr·dr)/2 = 0.5*(si − (wr·dr − wi·di)) ✓ matches line 80. Good.

3. Nyquist: X[M]=X[N/2]=sum (−1)^j x[j]. sum even − sum odd. Z[0] = sum z[n] = (sum even) + i(sum odd). So Re(Z[0])−Im(Z[0]) = even−odd ✓. And in code, at k==0, address=0, partner=0, so ar=Zr[0], ai=Zi[0], br=bi same. Store real = ar−ai ✓. Line 83 index: (row*(M+1)+M+0*k)*2 = element [row, M, 0] ✓. Imag 0 ✓. But wait — line 83 mask k==0: writes (ar−ai) where ar,ai are the k==0 lane values (Z[0]). ✓.

4. DIF butterfly. Standard DIF: for stage with sublength width, split k into halves. Standard decimation-in-frequency Cooley-Tukey: for j in 0..half-1: upper[j] = a[j]+a[j+half]; lower[j] = (a[j]−a[j+half])·W_width^j. Here k ranges over all M; left = k & ~half clears bit; right = k|half sets it. For k with bit half clear (lower==true): ar,br = a[left],a[right], result = ar+br ✓. For bit set: result = (a[left]−a[right])·W where W should be W_width^{k mod half}... W_width = e^{−2πi/width}. Phase in table units: phase/256 = j/width → phase = 256·j/width where j = k mod half = k & (half−1). Code: (k & (half-1))*(256//width) ✓ exactly.

But wait — DIF stage ordering: normally stage 1 has width=M, half=M/2, next width=M/2, ... down to width=2. Here stage 0: width=M>>0=M. ✓. Number of stages LOG_M=log2(M) ✓.

After DIF, output in bit-reversed order: element at position k holds Z[reverse(k)]. Code gathers from real at address=reverse(k) → gets Z[k] ✓. partner = (−address)&(M−1) = reverse of (M−k) mod M — since reverse(−k mod M)=−reverse(k) mod M ✓. So br = Z[M−k] ✓.
